newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul Poong Sung withdraws initial public offering.
newsitem.headline: Seoul Poong Sung withdraws initial public offering.

text.p: South Korea's Poong Sung Electric Co Ltd said on Monday it had decided to withraw a plan to go public due to troubles in the Kia Group.
The auto part producer is a subcontractor to Kia Motors and Asia Motors.
Creditor banks last week selected 18 of Kia's 38 affiliates for rescue and Kia announced a drastic plan to slim down.

"We are determined to delay the initial public offering plan until business in both Kia and Asia Motors becomes normal and accordingly their payments will be made smoothly," a Poong Sung statement said.
Poong Sung orginally planned to list 860,000 shares on the Korea Stock Exchange.
Subscription had been set for July 23-24 at 19,000 won per share.
